blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of handcrafted ciders, meads, brandies, and craft beers made with fresh and local ingredients. The venue offers an all-day menu including starters, tacos, sandwiches, and house specialties, with many meat dishes braised in their craft ciders. Weekly events and private parties are hosted in their upstairs loft and outdoor patio.
extraNote: Pricing is subject to change · At SoCal Vibes Co. shared production facility, 17812 S Main Street, Carson, CA 90248
